Additional comments:

questions.answer: it was a bit inconvenient (and old-school) having to go in person to the host institution in order to register

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: a website page

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: successful!

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: to check the exam mode and conditions in terms of attendance

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: courses were MA levels with a few BA students

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: really different in terms of intensity, since at the host institution it was few ECTS and only 1hour per week

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: decisions support systems, ecology of aquatic systems, field camp I, frontiers in social ecology and sustainability, global change and pest management, human impacts in the riverine landscape, mountain hazard processes, plant and environment, soil ecology

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
questions.answer: master thesis

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Field camp I, it's an introduction course in forest ecology, immersive as it takes the shape of a 1 week excursion with (almost exclusively) erasmus students. Best course of the year, also amazing to discover austrian landscapes.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The BOKU garden: you gain knowledge about plants and gardening, and are able to grow your own plants during the season

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Flea markets

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: The language is a bit of a barrier, though most people speak good english.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The language

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The diversity

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: to enjoy the time there and let the uni spirit guide them: BOKU has very different methods compared to UCPH (eg: no deadlines, more felxibility in exams/courses...) and it is the opportunity to take it slow and stop rushing

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nothing comes to mind

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The knowledge acquired, as well as the study method (learning to take it slow, deal with stress differently, approach the exams differently, put a lot of importance into mental health...)

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Dealing with the schedule that can be a bit messy

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
